name: Sofa reupholstery
summary: How expats decide between sofa reupholstery and replacement in Singapore — fabric choices for humidity, foam collapse, and turnaround when the living room is the kids’ trampoline.
body:
Reupholstery replaces fabric/leather and sometimes foam on a sound frame. In humid flats, fabric selection and mould risk matter as much as colour. Sometimes replacement is cheaper than labour — get both quotes.

## When reupholstery wins
- Solid timber frame you like
- Sentimental or odd-size pieces that fit the condo wall
- Leather cracks with salvageable structure
- Custom fabric to match renovation leftover palettes

If springs are shot and frames split, walk toward replacement.

## Process
Inspection, fabric sampling, foam grade choices, pickup/delivery, and 2–6 week timelines are common. Ask about stain treatments and pet-hair realities. Confirm whether piping/cushions are included.

## How to choose
Prefer workshops that show frame photos during strip-down. Get written fabric metreage and foam density. Be sceptical of ultra-cheap “same week leather paint” instead of proper recover.

## Practical tip
Keep a fabric cutting for future stain-repair matching. Photograph seam details before pickup so the return piece matches your memory.
